   Content: ## Redemption options and values

7. Internal: Freezing and Unfreezing a Debit Card
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026
   Score: 14.6331
   Content: Procedure for when a customer wants to temporarily freeze or unfreeze their debit card.

## Freezing vs. Closing

- FREEZE: Temporary lock - card can be unfrozen later. Use when customer misplaced the card or wants temporary security.
- CLOSE: Permanent deactivation - cannot be reversed. Use when card is confirmed lost/stolen or customer wants to cancel.

## Reasons for Freezing

- Customer misplaced the card and is looking for it
- Traveling and wants extra security
- Suspicious activity noticed, wants to investigate before closing
- Temporarily restricting spending (e.g., budgeting purposes)
- Lending card to family member and wants to control usage

## Freezing Requirements

1. Customer must be verified
2. Customer must be the owner of the debit card
3. Card must currently be in ACTIVE status (cannot freeze PENDING, CLOSED, or already FROZEN cards)

## Freezing Steps

1. Verify customer identity
2. Ask customer why they want to freeze the card
3. Inform customer of the following:
   - All new transactions will be declined while frozen
   - Recurring payments/subscriptions will also be declined
   - Pending transactions already authorized may still process
   - They can unfreeze at any time by calling customer service or through the mobile app
4. Use freeze_debit_card_3892 with the card_id
5. Confirm the freeze was successful

## Unfreezing Requirements

1. Customer must be verified
2. Customer must be the owner of the debit card
3. Card must currently be in FROZEN status
4. The linked checking account must still be OPEN

## Unfreezing Steps

1. Verify customer identity
2. Use unfreeze_debit_card_3893 with the card_id
3. Confirm the card is now active and ready to use immediately

## Important Notes

- Freezing does not affect ATM access if the customer has their PIN
- For ATM freeze, customer must also enable 'ATM Block' separately through mobile app
- If a frozen card is not unfrozen within 90 days, the customer will receive a reminder notification
- If customer confirms the card is lost/stolen, recommend closing instead of freezing

9. Platinum Reserve Account: Business Credit Card APY Bonuses
   ID: doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_010
   Score: 14.0007
   Content: ## Eligible Business Credit Cards and APY Bonuses

Holding an eligible Rho-Bank Business Rewards Card can increase the APY on your Platinum Reserve Account. The increase is additive to your current APY and is reflected in your displayed rate and daily interest accruals.

- Business Silver Rewards Card: adds 0.25% to your APY
- Business Gold Rewards Card: adds 0.5% to your APY
- Business Platinum Rewards Card: adds 0.8% to your APY

## How the APY Bonus Is Applied

- The bonus is added as a fixed number of percentage points to your Platinum Reserve Account’s APY based on your eligible card tier.
- The bonus is included in your total APY and affects interest that accrues daily and credits on your normal interest crediting schedule.
- The bonus applies only for the period during which you are eligible; if eligibility begins or ends mid-cycle, the APY used for daily accruals adjusts as of the effective date of that change.

## Verifying Your Bonus

- Check the APY shown in your Platinum Reserve Account details; the increase from your eligible card will be included in the displayed APY.
- Your interest activity will reflect the higher daily accrual associated with the bonus.
- If you hold more than one eligible card or have recently changed cards, contact your Rho-Bank representative to confirm which bonus is currently applied.

## Maintaining Eligibility

To keep the APY bonus active:
- Ensure the eligible Business Rewards Card remains active and in good standing.
- Keep the card associated with the same business entity that owns the Platinum Reserve Account.
- Notify Rho-Bank promptly if your business ownership structure or card status changes, so your APY can be updated accordingly.

## Starting, Changing, or Removing a Bonus

- New or upgraded card: Once eligibility is confirmed, your APY will reflect the applicable bonus going forward.
- Card downgrade, closure, or ineligibility: The APY bonus will no longer apply from the effective date of the change.
- Multiple cards: If your organization holds multiple eligible cards, your account will reflect the applicable bonus for your configuration; contact your Rho-Bank representative if you need confirmation.

## Example (for illustration only)

- If your Platinum Reserve Account APY is 3.00% and you hold a Business Platinum Rewards Card, your APY would increase by 0.8% to 3.80%.
- If your APY is 2.75% and you hold a Business Gold Rewards Card, your APY would increase by 0.5% to 3.25%.
- If your APY is 2.25% and you hold a Business Silver Rewards Card, your APY would increase by 0.25% to 2.50%.

10. Silver Account: Platinum Rewards Card holder benefits
   ID: doc_savings_accounts_silver_account_009
   Score: 13.9911
   Content: ## Overview

Silver Account holders who also have a Platinum Rewards Card receive enhanced withdrawal privileges. Your monthly withdrawal limit is increased by 5 additional free withdrawals, bringing your total to 10 + 5 = 15 withdrawals per month. This benefit is automatically applied when both accounts are linked under the same customer profile. Combined with the existing 15 ATM fee rebates and 0.025% relationship bonus, Platinum Rewards Card holders get an elevated Silver Account experience.

## APY bonuses from credit cards
- Platinum Rewards Card: +0.2%
- Diamond Elite Card: +0.25%

## What you receive as a Platinum Rewards Card holder

- Additional free withdrawals: +5 per month on top of your standard 10 free withdrawals
- Total free withdrawals per month: 10 + 5 = 15
- ATM fee relief: Up to 15 in ATM fee rebates each month
- Earnings boost: An additional 0.025% relationship bonus added to your APY when eligible

## Activation and eligibility

- The enhanced withdrawal limit is automatically applied when your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card are linked under the same customer profile.
- The 0.025% relationship bonus and 15 ATM fee rebates apply in the same profile-linked setup.

### How to confirm your accounts are linked

1. Sign in to Rho-Bank Online Banking or the mobile app.
2. Open your customer profile and review your list of accounts and cards.
3. Verify that your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card appear under the same customer profile.
4. If you do not see both products under one profile, consolidate them to a single profile or contact us for assistance.

## Using your monthly withdrawal allowance

- Counting method: Any transaction classified as a withdrawal under your Silver Account terms counts toward your monthly total of 15 free withdrawals.
- Cycle timing: Your free withdrawal count resets at the start of each monthly statement cycle.
- Beyond the limit: Transactions above your free monthly total may be subject to standard Silver Account withdrawal charges.

Example:
- You make 12 withdrawals in a month: all 12 are free.
- You make 15 withdrawals in a month: all 15 are free.
- You make 16 withdrawals in a month: the first 15 are free; the 16th may incur standard charges.

## ATM fee rebates

- You are eligible for up to 15 in ATM fee rebates each month.
- Rebates apply after ATM fees post to your Silver Account; check your transaction history for the corresponding credit within the same month.

## Relationship bonus APY

- When your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card are linked under the same customer profile, an additional 0.025% is added to your APY as a relationship bonus.
- The relationship bonus is reflected in your APY while eligibility is maintained.

## Troubleshooting and tips

- If you do not see the extra withdrawals or 0.025% reflected, confirm both products are under the same customer profile.
- Check that you are within the current monthly statement cycle for the added withdrawals to apply.
- Review your transaction history to verify ATM fee charges and corresponding rebates up to 15 for the month.

6. Internal: Freezing and Unfreezing a Debit Card
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026
   Score: 8.7410
   Content: Procedure for when a customer wants to temporarily freeze or unfreeze their debit card.

## Freezing vs. Closing

- FREEZE: Temporary lock - card can be unfrozen later. Use when customer misplaced the card or wants temporary security.
- CLOSE: Permanent deactivation - cannot be reversed. Use when card is confirmed lost/stolen or customer wants to cancel.

## Reasons for Freezing

- Customer misplaced the card and is looking for it
- Traveling and wants extra security
- Suspicious activity noticed, wants to investigate before closing
- Temporarily restricting spending (e.g., budgeting purposes)
- Lending card to family member and wants to control usage

## Freezing Requirements

1. Customer must be verified
2. Customer must be the owner of the debit card
3. Card must currently be in ACTIVE status (cannot freeze PENDING, CLOSED, or already FROZEN cards)

## Freezing Steps

1. Verify customer identity
2. Ask customer why they want to freeze the card
3. Inform customer of the following:
   - All new transactions will be declined while frozen
   - Recurring payments/subscriptions will also be declined
   - Pending transactions already authorized may still process
   - They can unfreeze at any time by calling customer service or through the mobile app
4. Use freeze_debit_card_3892 with the card_id
5. Confirm the freeze was successful

## Unfreezing Requirements

1. Customer must be verified
2. Customer must be the owner of the debit card
3. Card must currently be in FROZEN status
4. The linked checking account must still be OPEN

## Unfreezing Steps

1. Verify customer identity
2. Use unfreeze_debit_card_3893 with the card_id
3. Confirm the card is now active and ready to use immediately

## Important Notes

- Freezing does not affect ATM access if the customer has their PIN
- For ATM freeze, customer must also enable 'ATM Block' separately through mobile app
- If a frozen card is not unfrozen within 90 days, the customer will receive a reminder notification
- If customer confirms the card is lost/stolen, recommend closing instead of freezing

7. FAQ: Troubleshooting
   ID: doc_checking_accounts_checking_accounts_(general)_002
   Score: 8.0106
   Content: ## Quick checks to resolve common issues
- Ensure the customer is using the latest version of the mobile app or a supported web browser.
- Confirm the account is active and the customer is signed in with the correct profile.
- Verify that connectivity is stable and ask the customer to try a different network if possible.
- If the user experiences any issues with the website, they should try refreshing their cache using the `refresh_cache` tool.

## User-callable tool: Refresh cached site data
Provide the following tool directly to the user and instruct them to run it. Do not execute it on their behalf.
- Tool signature: `refresh_cache()`
- What to tell the user: “Please run the `refresh_cache()` tool to clear your cached site data and reload the latest version of the website.”
- Why this replaces manual steps: Instead of walking through browser settings, provide the exact tool name (and parameters, if any) so the user can perform the refresh immediately.

## Scenario-based guidance
- Balance not updating after a deposit: Ask the user to sign out and back in after running `refresh_cache()`. Then recheck the account activity screen.
- Transaction missing or pending: Review pending activity; some card authorizations and merchant adjustments take time to finalize.
- Transfers appear stuck: Confirm destination account details and any external bank maintenance notices; recheck status after a refreshed session.
- Sign-in problems: Verify correct username, recent password changes, and that the customer is not using a VPN that could trigger additional security checks.

## When to escalate
- The issue persists across devices and networks after the user runs `refresh_cache()` and signs back in.
- The customer reports specific error codes or repeated failures initiating payments, deposits, or transfers.
- Security concerns (e.g., suspected unauthorized access) or account access lockouts.

10. Why am I being charged a fee on my Lime Green Account?
   ID: doc_business_checking_accounts_lime_green_008
   Score: 7.4028
   Content: ## Common reasons you may see a fee

You may see one or more of the following fees on your Lime Green Account:

- Monthly maintenance fee if your balance does not meet the waiver threshold
- Fees for sending domestic or international wire transfers
- Fees for using non‑Rho ATMs, including percentage‑based fees for foreign ATM withdrawals

### Quick reference

| Fee type | When it’s charged | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly maintenance fee | Your balance does not meet the waiver threshold | $25.00 |
| Domestic wire transfer | You send a domestic wire | $10.00 |
| International wire transfer | You send an international wire to a foreign bank | $25.00 |
| Non‑Rho ATM (U.S.) | You withdraw cash at a non‑Rho ATM in the U.S. | $1.00 |
| Foreign ATM withdrawal | You withdraw cash at an international ATM | 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, minimum $2.50 |

## Monthly maintenance fee

- You are charged $25.00 when your account balance does not meet $15,000.
- To avoid this fee, maintain a balance at or above $15,000.

## Wire transfer fees

- Domestic wires: Each outgoing domestic wire you send incurs a fee of $10.00.
- International wires: Each outgoing international wire to a foreign bank incurs a fee of $25.00.

## ATM‑related fees

- Non‑Rho ATMs in the U.S.: You are charged $1.00 per withdrawal when using a non‑Rho ATM.
- Foreign (international) ATMs: You are charged 1.5% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum fee of $2.50.
  - How to estimate: Multiply your withdrawal amount by 1.5% and compare the result to $2.50. The higher number is the fee.

## How to confirm which fee was charged

1. Review your transaction history for a separate fee line item (for example, a description referencing maintenance, wire, or ATM).
2. Match the amount to one of the following:
   - $25.00
   - $10.00
   - $25.00
   - $1.00
   - For foreign ATM withdrawals, the greater of:
     - 1.5% of your withdrawal amount, or
     - $2.50

## Ways to avoid or reduce fees

- Maintain a balance of at least $15,000 to waive $25.00.
- Use Rho‑network ATMs to avoid the $1.00.
- Plan international cash needs to minimize the number of foreign ATM withdrawals subject to 1.5% (minimum $2.50).

## If you believe a fee is incorrect

- Gather details (date, amount, and description of the fee; related transaction, if any).
- Contact support with these details so we can review and correct any errors promptly.

5. Understanding Your Credit Card Rewards Categories
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_019
   Score: 8.2088
   Content: One of the great benefits of your Rho-Bank credit card is the ability to earn rewards on your everyday purchases. To help you maximize your earnings, it's important to understand how reward categories work and which types of purchases qualify for bonus rewards on your specific card.

## How Reward Categories Work

Every Rho-Bank credit card earns rewards on all purchases, but certain categories of spending may earn you bonus rewards at a higher rate. Your card has a base reward rate that applies to all purchases, plus bonus categories where you can earn even more. The specific bonus categories and rates vary depending on which Rho-Bank credit card you have.

## Available Reward Categories

Rho-Bank recognizes the following spending categories for rewards purposes:

- **Travel**: Flights, hotels, car rentals, cruises, and other travel-related purchases
- **Dining**: Restaurants, cafes, bars, and food delivery services
- **Groceries**: Supermarkets, grocery stores, and specialty food shops
- **Entertainment**: Movies, concerts, sporting events, and streaming services
- **Shopping**: Retail stores, department stores, and online marketplaces
- **Utilities**: Electric, gas, water, internet, and phone bills
- **Transportation**: Rideshare services, public transit, parking, and tolls
- **Software**: Software subscriptions, licenses, and cloud services
- **Media**: Advertising spend and digital media purchases
- **Green/Sustainable**: Eco-friendly merchants and sustainable products
- **Operations**: Business operational expenses

## Maximizing Your Rewards

To get the most out of your rewards, we recommend using your Rho-Bank credit card for purchases in your card's bonus categories whenever possible. You can find your specific card's bonus categories and reward rates by logging into your account on the Rho-Bank mobile app or website, or by reviewing your card's terms and conditions.

If you have any questions about which category a particular merchant falls into, or how to maximize your rewards earning potential, our customer service team is always happy to help. Give us a call at 1-800-RHO-BANK or chat with us through the mobile app.

9. Why isn't my QR code scanning?

- Screen glare or low brightness is obscuring the pattern.
- The camera cannot focus due to distance, motion, or a dirty lens.

10. Depositing a Check Into Your Account
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_011
   Score: 6.4123
   Content: ## Summary
Customers can deposit checks into their checking or savings accounts using mobile check deposit. To help a customer deposit a check, give them the deposit_check_3847 tool. Have the user call deposit_check_3847(account_id, check_amount) where account_id is the ID of the account they want to deposit into and check_amount is the amount of the check in USD. The customer will take a photo of the front and back of the check through their mobile banking app. Funds availability depends on the account type and deposit amount. Standard deposits are typically available within 1-2 business days. Note: The agent cannot deposit checks on behalf of the customer - this action must be performed by the customer themselves through the mobile app.

## Before you start
- Confirm the check is payable to the account owner(s) and is not altered or damaged.
- Endorse the back of the check. Include any required restrictive endorsement (for example, “For mobile deposit only”).
- Ensure the check date and numeric/written amounts match.

## Step-by-step: Mobile check deposit
1. Open the Rho-Bank mobile app and sign in.
2. Select the checking or savings account you want to deposit into.
3. Choose Mobile Check Deposit.
4. Enter the check amount exactly as printed.
5. Capture photos:
   - Front: all four corners visible, no shadows or glare.
   - Back: clear endorsement and all corners visible.
6. Review deposit details, confirm the destination account, and submit.
7. Keep the paper check in a secure place until the deposit is posted, then destroy it.

## If you are working with an agent
- To help you initiate the process, the agent will provide access to the deposit_check_3847 tool.
- You will be prompted to call deposit_check_3847(account_id, check_amount) from within the app’s flow to specify the destination account and the amount.
